definition: A landman is a professional who negotiates land titles and mineral leases on behalf of an oil and gas exploration company.
core_idea: Landmen identify and contact potential land/mineral-rights sellers on behalf of an exploration company and then negotiate the resulting lease or purchase contracts.
key_points: Landmen act as the exploration company's representative for identifying willing sellers of mineral rights.
They also handle negotiation of the resulting contracts once a willing owner is found.
